testScenarios.notes: DC is battery powered and power adapter is unplugged; AC is using power adapter
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1- In Settings->Battery Saver setting, enable/check "Turn battery saver on automatically if my battery falls below:" (If an option "always" turn on battery saver is available, select this  option) 
2-  Battery saver level is set to above actual current battery level 
3- Check "Lower Screen Brightness while in battery" 
4- Enable "Battery saver status until next charge" 
5- Adjust brightness level to mid-high 
6- Plug-in power supply 
7- Unplug power supply
testScenarios.passFailCriteria:
1) Screen dims accordingly with battery saver enabled 
2) Dimmed screen when battery is enabled while in DC mode persists after power transition (resume from CS, resume from hibernate, warm re-start, cold boot)

testScenarios.detailedSteps: While auto-brightness is off, adjust brightness level incrementally from the lowest level, and vice versa from the highest level.
testScenarios.passFailCriteria:
1) Confirm that brightness adjusts accordingly, and granularity in luminosity is according to spec. 
2) Action Center Brightness slider is in synched with Settings Display  Brightness 
3) No display anomalies should occur. Report any anomalies or anything not appearing normal

testScenarios.detailedSteps: Press F6 (for dim), F7 (for bright)
testScenarios.passFailCriteria: 1) Display luminance changes with keyboard brightness up/down. 2) Correct settings is reflected in the UI that appears on the top left corner
